lead_raw_text:
The structure of LiCoSi₂ crystallizes in the trigonal space group P-31m (No. 143), with a unit cell containing four atoms and three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for Co, Li, and Si centers, each with 12 geometric neighbors; Co and Li are surrounded by 12 Si neighbors, while Si has 6 Co and 6 Li neighbors, with neighbor distances from 2.3582 to 2.5101 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all four sites. Validated polyhedron contacts show Si–Si 12-vertex polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, and Co–Li polyhedra sharing corners and edges.
